title: No hostels or buses, MBBS students of Karimnagar GMC on strike
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — TELANGANA
key_facts: The union has begun a strike at Karimnagar, affecting bus services.
The union said long-pending issues behind the strike were raised with the government.
The union has asked the government for talks and a written resolution.
image_rights: branded graphic only; no third-party photograph used
bullets_en: The union has begun a strike at Karimnagar, affecting bus services.
The union said long-pending issues behind the strike were raised with the government.
The union has asked the government for talks and a written resolution.
bullets_ur: The union ne Karimnagar par strike shuru ki hai, jis se bus services mutasir hain.
Union ne kaha ke strike ke peeche arse se baqi masle government ke saamne rakhe gaye hain.
Union ne government se baat cheet aur likhit resolution ka mutalba kiya hai.
